notes.encryption_key: Generate a 32-byte AES-256 key using: go run implant/sliver/transports/outlook/keygen.go
notes.session_id: Use a unique identifier for each implant session (UUID recommended)
notes.jitter: Percentage of jitter to apply to poll interval (0-100)
notes.delete_after: WARNING: Set to true to delete emails after processing (stealth vs forensics trade-off)
